RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

A panel's composition isn't evidence of bias — all-male panels hire women and vice versa. Planning and public-engagement fields skew female in many municipalities, so four women on a panel may simply reflect the applicant and management pool.

Your credentials look stronger on paper, but director roles often turn on political judgement, council relations, consultation skills and interview performance — not degree level. "Extensive public consultation experience" may be exactly what the council wanted after a contentious file.

Raising the panel's sex would read as sour grapes and damage your reputation in a small professional world. Instead, chase the written explanation (politely, in writing, citing policy), and request a debrief on how to strengthen your candidacy next time.
